_comment: Key Hebrew/Aramaic/Greek terms with their fixed English renderings. Injected into every prompt. Grows as the project proceeds.

hebrew.האדם (ha-adam): the human (until used as the proper name Adam)
hebrew.נפש (nephesh): context-dependent: life, being, self, appetite, throat — never 'soul' by default
hebrew.תורה (torah): teaching (or 'law' only in clearly legal contexts)
hebrew.שלום (shalom): peace (or wholeness, well-being, where context demands)

greek.κύριος (kyrios): the Lord ('the LORD' only in explicit OT YHWH citations)
greek.μετάνοια (metanoia): a change of heart / to turn back
greek.ψυχή (psychē): context-dependent: life, self, being — never 'soul' by default
greek.πνεῦμα (pneuma): Spirit / spirit / breath / wind by context
